title: Why does checkout keep spinning?
label: CUSTOMER PROBLEM
voice: Asha's checkout times out. Platform threads stay occupied waiting for responses. When the request thread pool fills, new shoppers queue.
note: The server can be short of threads even with spare CPU.

title: Virtual threads help more requests progress
label: HOW JAVA 21 HELPS
voice: Virtual threads are lightweight. During supported network waits, Java frees the underlying operating system thread for other requests. More checkouts can progress together.
status: Pause waiting request → reuse carrier → resume
note: Like a waiter helping another table while food cooks.

title: The kitchen still has a limit
label: DEPENDENCY CAPACITY
voice: This helps when threads were the bottleneck. Payment is not faster. Twenty database connections still allow only twenty connections at once.
note: Illustrative limits; no measured speedup is claimed.

title: One checkout, one payment identity
label: MAKE RETRIES SAFE
voice: Save one payment attempt. Repeated clicks reuse its reference. A timeout does not prove payment failed.
note: A changed payload with the same key is a conflict.

title: Protect the systems doing the work
label: BOUNDED CALLS + BACKPRESSURE
voice: A bulkhead bounds active calls and waiting work. Give busy guidance only before payment starts. Keep database transactions short.
status: 20 active · 10 waiting · excess work gets busy guidance
note: A bulkhead is a bounded waiting room for a dependency.

title: Timeout? Check the original payment
label: HONEST STATUS + RECOVERY
voice: Set network deadlines. For uncertain payment, show checking and query the original provider reference before confirming. Never blindly pay again.
status: UNKNOWN → lookup original reference → verified result
note: A local timeout may leave remote work running.

title: Efficient waiting. Safer checkout.
label: THE COMPLETE IMPROVEMENT
voice: Virtual threads improve waiting efficiency. Capacity limits protect dependencies. Safe recovery protects Asha's payment. Checkout needs all three.
status: Concurrency + capacity protection + safe payment recovery
note: Article, simulation and video follow this same story.
